svg.title: Tablestock binder — organic-straight — m06-paper
svg.desc: Open recipe binder illustration (organic frame, thin-branch fork-tree, straight text lines), colourway m06-paper, centred on a square canvas.
svg.metadata:  binder-edition vector production dated 2026-10-10. The open recipe binder is Natasha's own illustration derived from her 2026-09-05 sketch; the Fraunces wordmark is outlined under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. No embedded rasters, gradients, filters, stock graphics, or third-party logo elements.
